test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to improve it. If no improvement is required, select ‘No improvement required’.

The pollution level __ought to keep__ under control.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase "ought to keep" is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**ought to be kept"** to **indicate the necessity of maintaining control over the pollution level.**
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence should read: "The pollution level ought to be kept under control."

Hence, the correct statement is** '*The pollution level ought to be kept under control*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Always ensure that the verb form matches the context of the sentence for correct grammatical structure.
 
 
• **Example:** *The rules **ought to be **followed by everyone.*
